title: Mr. District Attorney
paragraphs: A crime drama centered on an unnamed district attorney and his staff as they investigate and prosecute racketeers, killers, corrupt officials, and other criminals.

Crime/procedural franchise centered first on an unnamed crusading district attorney (Jay Jostyn), then on Paul Garrett in the Ziv transcribed David Brian version, followed by a late Mutual Jostyn return.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Blue Network launch era (April 3, 1939 to April 7, 1940) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], NBC/Bristol-Myers era (April 11, 1940 to 1951-08) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], ABC final network season (1951-09 to June 13, 1952) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and Ziv transcribed Paul Garrett version (August 10, 1952 to August 4, 1953) on [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Phillips H. Lord (creator and performer), [[person|jay-jostyn|Jay Jostyn]] (performer), Len Doyle (performer), Vicki Vola (performer), David Brian (performer), Peter Van Steeden (music director and music), and Robert Shaw (writer and director).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]], [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]], and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]].

The stories often return to public corruption and abuse of office, criminal prosecution and court process, murder and homicide, fraud, swindles and financial crime, public safety and civic protection, and racketeering and organized crime.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Prosecutorial anti-racketeering model, Bristol-Myers dramatic sponsorship, Crime drama addressing social problems, and Transcribed syndication and cross-media expansion.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]], [[show|cbs-radio-workshop|CBS Radio Workshop]], [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]].
